∀ {n : Nat} {B : Type u_1} (block : Fin n → B) (A D N : Research.BlockJacobi.RealMatrix n)
  (b x : Research.BlockJacobi.Vector n),
  Research.BlockJacobi.IsBlockDecomposition.{u_1} block A D N →
    IsUnit.{0} (Matrix.det.{0, 0} D) →
      Eq.{1} (Matrix.mulVec.{0, 0, 0} A x) b →
        And
          (∀ (x₀ : Research.BlockJacobi.Vector n) (k : Nat),
            And
              (Eq.{1} (Matrix.mulVec.{0, 0, 0} D (Research.BlockJacobi.correction A D b x₀ k))
                (HSub.hSub.{0, 0, 0} b (Matrix.mulVec.{0, 0, 0} A (Research.BlockJacobi.iterate A D b x₀ k))))
              (And
                (Eq.{1} (Research.BlockJacobi.iterate A D b x₀ (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} k 1))
                  (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (Research.BlockJacobi.iterate A D b x₀ k)
                    (Research.BlockJacobi.correction A D b x₀ k)))
                (And
                  (Eq.{1} (Research.BlockJacobi.error A D b x x₀ (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} k 1))
                    (Matrix.mulVec.{0, 0, 0} (Research.BlockJacobi.iterationMatrix D N)
                      (Research.BlockJacobi.error A D b x x₀ k)))
                  (And
                    (Eq.{1} (Research.BlockJacobi.error A D b x x₀ k)
                      (Matrix.mulVec.{0, 0, 0} (HPow.hPow.{0, 0, 0} (Research.BlockJacobi.iterationMatrix D N) k)
                        (Research.BlockJacobi.error A D b x x₀ 0)))
                    (And
                      (∀ (i : Fin n),
                        LE.le.{0} (Research.BlockJacobi.vectorAbs (Research.BlockJacobi.error A D b x x₀ k) i)
                          (Matrix.mulVec.{0, 0, 0}
                            (HPow.hPow.{0, 0, 0}
                              (Research.BlockJacobi.matrixAbs (Research.BlockJacobi.iterationMatrix D N)) k)
                            (Research.BlockJacobi.vectorAbs (Research.BlockJacobi.error A D b x x₀ 0)) i))
                      (LE.le.{0} (Research.BlockJacobi.vectorInfNorm (Research.BlockJacobi.error A D b x x₀ k))
                        (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0}
                          (HPow.hPow.{0, 0, 0}
                            (Research.BlockJacobi.matrixInfNorm (Research.BlockJacobi.iterationMatrix D N)) k)
                          (Research.BlockJacobi.vectorInfNorm (Research.BlockJacobi.error A D b x x₀ 0)))))))))
          (And
            (Eq.{1} (Research.BlockJacobi.rho (Research.BlockJacobi.iterationMatrix D N))
              (Research.BlockJacobi.rho (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (Inv.inv.{0} D) N)))
            (And
              (Iff
                (∀ (x₀ : Research.BlockJacobi.Vector n),
                  Filter.Tendsto.{0, 0} (Research.BlockJacobi.iterate A D b x₀) Filter.atTop.{0} (nhds.{0} x))
                (LT.lt.{0} (Research.BlockJacobi.rho (Research.BlockJacobi.iterationMatrix D N)) 1))
              (LT.lt.{0} (Research.BlockJacobi.matrixInfNorm (Research.BlockJacobi.iterationMatrix D N)) 1 →
                And
                  (∀ (x₀ : Research.BlockJacobi.Vector n),
                    Filter.Tendsto.{0, 0} (Research.BlockJacobi.iterate A D b x₀) Filter.atTop.{0} (nhds.{0} x))
                  (And (LE.le.{0} 0 (Research.BlockJacobi.matrixInfNorm (Research.BlockJacobi.iterationMatrix D N)))
                    (∀ (u v : Research.BlockJacobi.Vector n),
                      LE.le.{0}
                        (Research.BlockJacobi.vectorInfNorm
                          (HSub.hSub.{0, 0, 0} (Research.BlockJacobi.update A D b u)
                            (Research.BlockJacobi.update A D b v)))
                        (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0}
                          (Research.BlockJacobi.matrixInfNorm (Research.BlockJacobi.iterationMatrix D N))
                          (Research.BlockJacobi.vectorInfNorm (HSub.hSub.{0, 0, 0} u v))))))))
